 Equestrian Commission Meeting Minutes
September  3, 2024

6.  NEW BUSINESS

  a.  Mr. Wasserman introduced the new lease operator of the Sycamore
  Equestrian Center, Mr. Steve Jackson.
  Mr. Jackson reviews the stages the Equestrian Center is currently going
  through. First stage was transitioning to the new agreement and getting to
  know staff and the Center. The next stage is completing renovations of the
  stalls and increasing the maintenance around the Center including the
  Community Arena raking and equipment. Final stages will include bringing up
  to code the entire ranch and expanding the ranch, adding landscape and
  adding a covered arena in the future.

  Mr. Jackson commented on the positive feedback and success of the two
  horse shows that have occurred and third show coming up that is bring
  community to the ranch.

  Chair Andrade and Mr. Jackson commented on their shared interest in having
  a rodeo return to the City.

  Commissioner Pasillas asked Mr. Jackson for his motivation on taking on the
  project. Mr. Jackson explained his long- term love for the horses and working
  at a young age at an equestrian center.

  Mayor Badar asked how the organizations at the Equestrian Center doing
  with all the changes, the quality of hay status based on from community
  comments in the past and the status of the house on the property.

  Mr. Jackson stated Rising Stars group is doing very well and everyone is very
  professional and happy with the changes. The hay is from the Feed & Grain
  store from San Dimas and is happy with the quality of the hay but will make
  sure to keep an eye out on the quality.

  Mr. Ford commented on the current work, attention and plans going into the
  repairs and maintenance of the house on the property.

  b.  Appointment of Chair

  Mr. Wasserman opened the floor for Chair and Vice Chair nominations and
  reiterated the responsibilities of the Chair and Vice Chair.

  A motion by Chair Andrade to nominate Commissioner Pasillas for Chair was
  made and seconded by Commissioner Cravin, Approved unanimously.
